Promote accountability, communicate expectations and provide regular, constructive performance feedback; ensure performance management processes are timely, fair and meaningful. Ensure senior leaders and teams have access to the information, tools, resources, coaching and technical support required to perform effectively. Foster collaboration across programs and support functions and between country, regional and global teams FINANCE AND COMPLIANCE MANAGEMENT Provide overall accountability for the financial health and operational effectiveness and ensure resources are managed transparently, efficiently and in line with donor and Mercy Corps requirements. Promote a culture of integrity and ensure adherence to Mercy Corps’ Code of Conduct, ethics, safeguarding and related policies and procedures. Experience with major institutional donors such as USG, FCDO, ECHO, European donors, UN agencies, foundations
